pendentes.titulo: PC desligando sozinho: temperatura, fonte ou sistema?
pendentes.alt: Gabinete de computador aberto sobre uma bancada, com o cooler do processador e a fonte de alimentação à mostra
pendentes.pedido: A black mid-tower desktop computer case lying on its side on a clean wooden workbench, side panel removed, showing a CPU tower cooler with a large fan, neatly routed cables and a power supply unit at the bottom of the case. A small can of compressed air and a soft brush rest beside the case. A switched-off monitor stands slightly out of focus in the background. Soft daylight from a window on the left, shallow depth of field.

pendentes.titulo: Windows 11 ganha Cloud rebuild: reinstalação pela internet, sem pen drive
pendentes.alt: Gabinete de computador de mesa fechado sobre uma bancada de madeira, com um monitor apagado ao lado e um cabo de rede ligado na parte de trás
pendentes.pedido: A plain black mid-tower desktop computer case standing on a clean light wooden workbench, seen from a three-quarter rear angle, with a blue ethernet network cable plugged into the back. A switched-off monitor stands beside it, its dark screen turned slightly away from the camera. A small coiled cable rests on the bench. Soft natural daylight from a window on the left, shallow depth of field.

pendentes.titulo: Tela do notebook com mancha: quando é defeito e quando é pressão
pendentes.alt: Notebook preto de plástico aberto sobre uma bancada clara, com a tela apagada e um pano de microfibra dobrado ao lado
pendentes.pedido: A black plastic laptop with a thick bezel standing open on a light grey workbench, seen from a three-quarter side angle. The screen is switched off and dark, with a soft reflection of window light across it. A folded blue microfiber cloth lies next to the laptop. The keyboard is out of focus in the foreground. Soft natural daylight from the left, shallow depth of field.
